title: centaurea axillaris var. occitanica
intro: Centaurea axillaris var. occitanica, commonly known as Occitan Cornflower, is a plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its vibrant blue flowers and distinctive growth habit. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea axillaris var. occitanica include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
